Fails if still tilted, flat/ungraded, or if title text is baked in.

AO-123.check: Series variant is a 1280x720 indigo-overlay of the thumbnail
AO-123.pass_condition: course_thumbnail_series_variant.png decodes as a valid PNG measuring 1280x720 = the graded thumbnail with a subtle deep-indigo #23255A brand color overlay (image_apply_color_overlay). Fails if wrong dimensions or no visible indigo brand tint versus the base thumbnail.

AO-123.check: Intro title-card plate is an opaque indigo-wash plate with a gold title band
AO-123.pass_condition: intro_titlecard_plate.png is an opaque PNG (no alpha transparency, or alpha fully opaque) measuring 1920x1080 = a deep-indigo brand-wash background with a warm-gold #F2B441 (RGB 242,180,65) title band solid-filled into a lower region (within +/-8 levels per channel on the band). Solid-color background/position reference only, NOT a transparent cutout and no text composited. Fails if transparent cutout, missing gold band, or text is baked in.

AO-123.check: Lower-third bar plate is an opaque deep-indigo solid-fill plate
AO-123.pass_condition: lower_third_bar_plate.png is an opaque PNG measuring 1920x1080 with a lower-left horizontal region solid-filled deep indigo #23255A (RGB 35,37,90) within +/-8 levels per channel. Solid-color swatch/position reference only, NOT a transparent cutout and no text composited. Fails if transparent cutout, wrong fill color, or text is baked in.

AO-123.check: Key-point caption-strip plate is an opaque brand-color solid-fill plate
AO-123.pass_condition: keypoint_caption_strip_plate.png is an opaque PNG measuring 1920x1080 with a lower-center strip region solid-filled the cream/indigo brand color. Solid-color position/swatch reference only, NOT a transparent cutout and no caption text composited. Fails if transparent cutout or if caption text is baked in.

AO-123.check: Logo is vectorized to a clean SVG
AO-123.pass_condition: meridian_logo.svg is a valid SVG whose markup contains vector path/shape geometry tracing the flat two-color Meridian Academy logo, not merely an embedded raster <image>. Fails if not valid SVG or if it only wraps a bitmap.

AO-123.check: Captions cue sheet is finalized with the eight key-point cues
AO-123.pass_condition: lesson_captions.json is a valid JSON array of exactly 8 cue objects {index, start_seconds, end_seconds, text} finalized from the supplied key-point lines (e.g. 'Interest earns interest', 'Rule of 72', '72 / rate = years to double', 'Compounding rewards patience'). Fails if not 8 cues or any cue is missing the index/start/end/text fields.

AO-123.check: No text/captions/grade composited onto the video deliverables
AO-123.pass_condition: Neither video carries burned-in text, lower-thirds, key-point captions, transitions, or a baked color grade from the automated pass — captions ship only as lesson_captions.json and the intro card/lower-third/caption strip ship only as standalone opaque plates. Fails if the master or promo has burned-in captions/lower-thirds or baked-in effects text.

AO-123.check: Handoff folder gathers every deliverable alongside the source
AO-123.pass_condition: meridian_lesson04_package_folder is one dated Creative Cloud folder containing all nine produced deliverables (16:9 master, ~15s promo, both thumbnails, all three plates, the logo SVG, and the captions JSON) alongside the source assets. Fails if deliverables are scattered or missing from the folder.
